cited_passage: IRS Newsroom, "It's not too late; use IRS Free File today," IR-2026-71 (June 2, 2026) — confirms post-deadline free filing availability through Oct. 15 and notes that late filers may still qualify for overlooked credits or refunds. Source: irs.gov/newsroom/its-not-too-late-use-irs-free-file-today.
